question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1
solution:
The correct answer is '**are**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the sentence is "Child prodigies," which is plural.
 
• Since the sentence is in the present tense, the correct auxiliary verb should also be in the present tense.
 
• "**Are**" is the correct present tense form that agrees with the plural subject.
 
• Other options ("**is**", "**was**", "**were**") do not correctly match the subject-verb agreement in the present tense.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.
